有画像简介即可初审；已有帖子和粉丝数据一并参考。缺少简介时无法审核，不等待补采。: A profile biography is enough for initial review. Existing posts and follower data are optional context. No biography means no review; collection is not required.
默认关闭。开启后，有画像简介即可批量 AI 初审；已有的关联帖子和粉丝数据一并参: Off by default. When enabled, batch AI screening requires only a profile biography. Existing related posts and follower data are optional; missing context does not block review. Without a biography, mark as unable to review and do not call AI or wait for profile collection or relationship checks. Passed accounts enter follow-back and follow queues; others stay for review. When disabled, accounts are admitted directly. The follow-back bypass controls later queue screening.
开始后按本批所选账号继续核验，切换页面、分类、搜索或分页不会终止。点击停止图标，: Verifies the accounts selected at the start. Changing pages, categories, search or pagination does not stop this batch. Use Stop to pause after the current account, then resume remaining accounts. Only updates local relationships; does not follow or unfollow.
完成当前账号后暂停，不再核验后续账号；已保存的结果保留。: Pause after the current account. Remaining accounts wait; saved results are kept.
待回关：已通过审核，等待关注队列处理。待审核：初审命中规则、无法判断或遗留问题。: Pending follow-back: approved and waiting for the follow queue. Pending review: matched a rule, uncertain, or needs attention. Accounts confirmed to have neither a following nor a follower relationship are cleaned up automatically. Unknown relationships require verification. Search covers all local accounts.
待回关：已放行并加入关注队列。待审核：等待 AI 或人工判断。待核实：补充详细资: Awaiting follow-back: approved and queued. Review: awaiting AI or human judgment. Verification: collect profile details and up to 10 recent posts, then review once more. Confirmed follow-backs become mutual.
X 未返回完整关注关系，已重试一次，请稍后重试: X did not return the full follow relationship after one retry. Try again later.
X 未返回该账号资料，已重试一次，请确认账号是否可访问: X did not return this profile after one retry. Check whether the account is accessible.
补采后资料仍不足，可重新核实: Information still insufficient after collection; verify again
通过后自动入队；不通过移除关注者；资料不足进入待核实。已有简介或有效帖子即可审核: Approved accounts enter the follow queue; rejected accounts are removed as followers; insufficient information goes to verification. A biography or usable posts are enough to review.

关注数 {{following}} 超过粉丝数 {{followers}} 的: Following {{following}} exceeds {{threshold}} times the follower count {{followers}}; skip follow-back and remove this follower
关注数未超过粉丝数的 {{threshold}} 倍，继续待回关放行: Following does not exceed {{threshold}} times the follower count; continue follow-back approval
自动调度参数无效：间隔 1–60 分钟，每轮 1–50 人，核实重试间隔 5–1: Invalid schedule: interval 1–60 minutes, 1–50 accounts per run, verification retry 5–1440 minutes
默认开启。按配置检查待审核账号，复用已有画像和帖子；通过自动加入待回关与关注队列: On by default. Review pending accounts using saved profiles and posts. Approved accounts enter the follow-back queue; rejected followers are removed; insufficient information goes to verification.
默认开启。补充画像及前 10 条帖子，已有缓存优先复用；补采完成后回到待审核。遵: On by default. Collect profile details and up to 10 posts, reusing cached data first. Return to review after collection. Respect the global access budget and retry interval.
初审与人工 AI 审核共用此上限。人工审核按完整提示词长度自动拆批，不截断原始资: Initial and manual AI reviews share this limit. Batches adapt to full prompt length without truncating evidence. Approval queues the account, rejection removes the follower, and insufficient information requests verification.
默认关闭。开启后，有画像简介即可批量 AI 初审；已有的关联帖子和粉丝数据一并参: Off by default. When enabled, use profile descriptions and available posts for AI review. Missing evidence goes to automatic verification. Approval queues a follow-back; rejection removes the follower. When disabled, new candidates pass directly. Queue screening follows the follow-back bypass setting.
记录审核结果及处理原因，技术异常不会当成审核不通过。: Review outcomes and reasons. Technical errors are separate from rejections.
记录账号关系核实、资料补采及重试原因。: Account relationship checks, additional data collection and retry reasons.
记录自动审核与核实的执行、等待原因及下次检查时间。: Automatic review and verification runs, wait reasons and next check times.
默认关闭。开启后，关键词与 AI 审核识别到有内容依据的色情低俗或性暗示引流时，: Off by default. When enabled, keyword and AI checks queue followers for removal when evidence shows sexual or suggestive promotional content.
默认关闭。开启后，核实确认简介和帖子都为空时移除；关闭时按该项放行。抓取失败、限: Off by default. Remove only after verification confirms both biography and posts are empty; otherwise allow under this rule. Failed requests, rate limits and private profiles do not count as empty.
